lines.text: The fool says in his heart that there is no God, and his acts are vile.
The LORD looks down from heaven to see who seeks God, but only half have turned away.
The workers of iniquity devour God's people like bread and refuse to call upon the LORD.
The sinners are overwhelmed with dread because God is with the righteous, and the LORD shelters the oppressed.
David longs for salvation to come from Bethel, and calls Jacob to rejoice when the LORD restores them.
